findings.text: _rev_parse now calls _resolve_commit in its non-strict mode, which returns the empty string for a TimeoutExpired or an OSError as well as for a revision that names no commit, so a landing that fails because git could not start or did not answer reports 'cannot resolve <rev> to a commit in <repo>' instead of the instrument fault the previous direct subprocess.run would have raised.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Verified the changed production code against reckon/crew/merge.py's own landing callers and reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2710,2780 for _rev_parse, and reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:489,885 for the check-line renderer; plan_coordinator.py is a docstring change in a module the ratchet records as unreached.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit: 334bdaeec makes the three production repairs (merge.py delegation, render_review_check in recovery_review_subject.py, docstring literal removal in plan_coordinator.py) and re-freezes three test files; 4436b98db adds only the landing fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names the six ids, a base arm and head arm from git archive extractions, per-id intent in the manifest, and ruff on the staged paths; logs/arm-base.log shows exactly those six FAILED and 161 passed, logs/arm-head.log shows 167 passed, and logs/head-gate.log shows 36 passed at 4436b98db.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to make the six census ids of §51 pass by asserting each intended contract or reporting the unintended change; docs/plans/the-suite-is-green-at-head.html#s51 names those six ids and the landed tests/test_one_function_resolves_a_citation.py::test_only_the_shared_resolver_peels_a_revision_to_a_commit is one of them, now green at head.

item_verdicts.write_paths: The declaration lists the six test files, reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py, reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py and reckon/crew/merge.py; the diff touches exactly those plus the always-permitted docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/each-one-owner-invariant-names-one-owner.html, and nothing outside them.

justifications.evidence: logs/arm-base.log fails exactly the six ids and logs/arm-head.log passes 167, both from git archive extractions with revision/tree/command headers and a bare EXIT line; the ruff claim is manifest-recorded rather than logged, and was verified independently.
justifications.fit: The production edits delegate to existing owners in the surrounding idiom (reckon/crew/merge.py:132 imports the resolver lazily) and introduce no name the repository naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Every one of the six ids listed at docs/plans/the-suite-is-green-at-head.html#s51 passes at 4436b98db in logs/head-gate.log, and the manifest's per-id table cites the intended commit for each.
justifications.reuse: No new capability is defined: reckon/crew/merge.py:132 extends the shared resolver at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:_resolve_commit, and reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:575 calls the existing render_review_check owner at reckon/crew/prompts.py:418.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 357349e44 4436b98db lists only the nine declared paths plus the always-permitted landing fragment, with no unrelated edit.
